hook.en: A company that only chases profit may cheat customers, overwork staff and soon lose its market. Successful businesses balance many objectives at the same time.
hook.kn: ಲಾಭವನ್ನೇ ಬೆನ್ನಟ್ಟುವ ಕಂಪನಿ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳು ಹಲವು ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸಮತೋಲನಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: List and explain the multiple objectives of business

narration.en: A company that only chases profit may cheat customers, overwork staff and soon lose its market. Successful businesses balance many objectives at the same time.
narration.kn: ಲಾಭವನ್ನೇ ಬೆನ್ನಟ್ಟುವ ಕಂಪನಿ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳು ಹಲವು ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸಮತೋಲನಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Profit is the excess of revenue over cost. It is a source of income for owners, a source of finance for expansion, an indicator of efficiency and a builder of reputation. But profit cannot be the only objective, because ignoring other interests can harm the business in the long run.

narration.en: Profit is the excess of revenue over cost. It is a source of income for owners, a source of finance for expansion, an indicator of efficiency and a builder of reputation. But profit cannot be the only objective, because ignoring other interests can harm the business in the long run.
narration.kn: ಲಾಭ ಮಾಲೀಕರ ಆದಾಯದ ಮೂಲ, ವಿಸ್ತರಣೆಗೆ ಹಣಕಾಸು, ದಕ್ಷತೆಯ ಸೂಚಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅದು ಏಕೈಕ ಉದ್ದೇಶವಾಗಬಾರದು.

title.en: On the board: Profit and objectives

narration.en: Profit is simply revenue minus cost.

say.en: Profit is simply revenue minus cost.
A shop sells goods worth five lakh rupees and its costs are four lakh twenty thousand. Its profit is eighty thousand.
Profit is income for owners, finance for expansion, a test of efficiency and a builder of reputation.
But profit cannot be the only objective. Peter Drucker lists eight areas that need objectives.
Remember: profit is necessary for survival, but long-run success needs all these objectives together.

body.en: Objectives are needed in every area where performance affects survival and prosperity. These areas are market standing, innovation, productivity, physical and financial resources, earning profits, manager performance and development, worker performance and attitude, and social responsibility.

narration.en: Objectives are needed in every area where performance affects survival and prosperity. These areas are market standing, innovation, productivity, physical and financial resources, earning profits, manager performance and development, worker performance and attitude, and social responsibility.
narration.kn: ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸ್ಥಾನ, ನಾವೀನ್ಯತೆ, ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ, ಭೌತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಹಣಕಾಸು ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳು, ಲಾಭ, ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳು.

caption.en: Revenue = price × units; total cost = fixed cost + variable cost × units. Profit is the gap between the lines.

narration.en: Move the sliders and watch the revenue line and the cost line. Where they cross, there is no profit and no loss.

tryThis.en: Raise the price to ₹80. How many fewer units are needed to break even?
Set fixed cost to zero. Where do the two lines meet now?
Find a price at which 800 units give a loss.

aim.en: To find the break-even point, P/V ratio and margin of safety from a break-even chart.

narration.en: In this lab you will draw a break-even chart and see how profit appears only after sales cross the break-even point.

problem.en: A dairy company in Hassan (a) launches a new flavoured buttermilk, (b) installs machines so that 10 workers now pack what 15 used to pack, (c) sets up a free drinking-water unit in a nearby village. Name the objective behind each step.

steps.en: (b) More output from the same or fewer inputs: productivity.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. A dairy company in Hassan (a) launches a new flavoured buttermilk, (b) installs machines so that 10 workers now pack what 15 used to pack, (c) sets up a free drinking-water unit in a nearby village. Name the objective behind each step.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of the PU board and CUET exams.

points.en: Profit is necessary for survival, growth and reputation.
points.kn: ಉಳಿವು, ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆಗೆ ಲಾಭ ಅಗತ್ಯ.

points.en: Business must set objectives in every key area, not profit alone.
points.kn: ಲಾಭ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಇಡಬೇಕು.

points.en: Market standing, innovation and productivity keep a firm competitive.
points.kn: ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸ್ಥಾನ, ನಾವೀನ್ಯತೆ, ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿಡುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Social responsibility is also a business objective.

homework.en: Explain any four objectives of business with an example from a firm in your town.

narration.en: Recap. Profit is necessary for survival, growth and reputation. Business must set objectives in every key area, not profit alone. Market standing, innovation and productivity keep a firm competitive. Social responsibility is also a business objective.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಉಳಿವು, ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆಗೆ ಲಾಭ ಅಗತ್ಯ. ಲಾಭ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಇಡಬೇಕು. ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸ್ಥಾನ, ನಾವೀನ್ಯತೆ, ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಉದ್ದೇಶ.
